theme: An open day with a warm recruiter note to answer.
greeting: The whole day is open, Dan — nothing on the calendar to steer around. The one thing worth doing is a short reply to Amin on the CIFIC search; the rest is the travel bookings that keep slipping.

needsAttention.title: Reply to Amin on the CIFIC search
needsAttention.detail: Amin Noorani, the executive-search partner you met virtually, wrote on the 15th with the VP, Government Relations & Regulatory Affairs mandate at CIFIC (JD attached) and is open to discussing it and to keeping you in mind for board seats. A short reply keeps a warm recruiter relationship live.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: The p1 item on the Mike + Dan board, overdue since Sept 14. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out — a refundable hold now costs nothing and removes the risk.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break destination
needsAttention.detail: Shortlist and decide, on the board — the Oct 15 book-by date has already slipped, and holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year.

flagged.title: CIFIC VP role — Amin Noorani
flagged.detail: Recruiter follow-up with the job description attached; a reply is owed.

flagged.title: Suspicious "document shared" email
flagged.detail: A Google-Docs-style share from Fran Philip's address links to doc.ivoryhill.org with a fake Google footer and undisclosed recipients — looks like phishing. Don't click.

inbox.noise: Otherwise just travel confirmations (Kiwi flights, Airbnb) and an alumni class-notes newsletter.

resolved: Toronto trip Nov 2–5 is booked — flights (Kiwi) and the Airbnb loft both confirmed over the weekend.

recipe.title: Apple galette
recipe.why: Autumn's orchard apples bake down sweet under a rustic free-form crust.

tasks.title: Place the Portland house order (bedframe + soap holder)

acts.line: Nothing is on the calendar before noon — the quiet is yours to spend on the thing that matters most.
The afternoon stays open too; a rare uninterrupted stretch with no meeting to break it.
The evening is clear, with the girls home — room to cook something slow from scratch.
